facts.text: Admissions decisions at Maranatha Baptist University require a clear salvation testimony of personal salvation in Jesus Christ and demonstrated good Christian character.

sources.title: Admissions Information - Maranatha Baptist University
sources.quote: The Admissions Committee will evaluate the following factors when making an admissions decision to the college: Clear salvation testimony of personal salvation in Jesus Christ. Good Christian character as identified in your essay and character references.
